en.html:
Sayo"'Revenge is an empty thing, the books say. What do you think?' So she asked me."
永倉翁"Oh?"
Sayo"Just like that. Dropped it out of her mouth."
永倉翁"And what answer did you give?"
Sayo"I sprayed my tea straight into her face."
永倉翁"...You do not spare a person, do you..."
Sayo"No, no. You must consider who was saying it. That young mistress of ours, asking such a question!"
永倉翁"Never in your dreams, eh. ...Haan. I can understand."
永倉翁"Has Lady Kanae changed a little?"
Sayo"That is how she appears to you?"
永倉翁"Ten years have passed. If nothing changed, that itself would be strange. Only... I had taken her for a person who would not change・・・・・・."
Sayo"Yes."
永倉翁"Was there something, then, that could change even the thing that would not change?"
Sayo"Who can say? There may have been."
永倉翁"That young fellow?"
Sayo"His mind does not take the straight road."

ja.html: さよ 「復讐は虚しい、なんて物の本に云うけれど。 　あなたはどう思う……と」
ja.text:
さよ
「復讐は虚しい、なんて物の本に云うけれど。
　あなたはどう思う……と」

en.html:
永倉翁"True enough. ...One would not put much hope in him for making somebody happy."
永倉翁"Did something in Lady Kanae find its match in him? Or was it quite the opposite?"
Sayo"Who knows?"
永倉翁"If a man can change her, then even Lady Kanae belongs among ordinary womennyoshou, does she? Nothing could be better, of course, but..."
Sayo"She does not change."
永倉翁"Hm."
Sayo"At the root・... What is in the child of three remains in the person of a hundred."
Sayo"Change takes place on the surface only. Underneath, it is the same—from the first beginning to the last end. Everyone, without exception."
永倉翁"Then from the beginning there has been no change at Lady Kanae's root... But which is it?"
永倉翁"Which of the two・・・ is her root?"
Sayo"Who can say?"
永倉翁"............"
Sayo"Which indeed..."

ja.html:
永倉翁 「そうよな。 　……およそ人を幸福にできるような男では なさそうだが」
永倉翁 「香奈枝様と、何か噛み合うものがあったか。 　それとも、逆か」
さよ 「さぁて」
永倉翁 「男で変わるなら、香奈枝様も凡百の女性にょしょうで あられたということかな。 　何より、結構なことだが……」
さよ 「変わりませぬよ」
永倉翁 「ふむ」
さよ 「根・は…… 　三つ子の魂百まで」
さよ 「変わるのは上辺だけ。 　大本はそのまま……発端から結尾まで。誰 も彼もが」
永倉翁 「香奈枝様も始めから、根はなにも変わって おらぬ……か。 　ならば、いずれが？」
永倉翁 「香奈枝様の根は、どちら・・・だな？」
さよ 「さぁて」
永倉翁 「…………」
さよ 「どちらでございましょう……」
